T: Cash, a mall, and a very good plan.
D: A flight attendant caught smuggling money plays the cops and a gun runner against each other.
P: Serve the snacks when the money swap happens at the shopping mall.
S: the switch at the Del Amo mall
Chicken thighs in a sweet soy and ginger glaze, threaded on skewers, grilled and brushed until sticky, with steamed rice.
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, chipotle crema and lime.
Peanuts tossed in lime zest, chilli powder and salt, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, served in little foil packets like on the plane.
M: the bail bondsman who falls for Jackie
Sirloin seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream and chives and a wedge salad with blue cheese.
Chicken brined in buttermilk and hot sauce overnight, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C, with collard greens and mac and cheese.
W: Moist banana bread with walnuts, toasted and buttered in thick slices. Mash 3 ripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs and vanilla.
K: 45ml vodka topped with fresh orange juice over ice.

s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 chipotle and lime juice. Serve in 12 warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, crema and lime wedges.

Toss 300g peanuts with the zest of 2 limes, 1 tsp chilli powder and flaky salt. Roast at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool and fold into four little foil packets, like the snacks on the flight to Cabo.

m.note: the bail bondsman who falls for Jackie
m.how: Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for an hour. Sear 4 sirloins, pull at 54C and rest. Cut an iceberg into 4 wedges and spoon over 100g blue cheese mixed with sour cream. Load the potatoes with sour cream and chives.

w.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs and vanilla. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and 80g walnuts and bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 55 minutes. Toast slices and butter them.

d.how: For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice, add 45ml vodka and top with about 150ml fresh orange juice. Stir and serve. Squeeze the oranges yourself if you've got time, it makes all the difference.
